svg.title: Week 18 of 36, Review and Assessment 2 (assess), sits in term 2, memory, then attention
svg.desc: Thirty-six week tiles in four lanes of nine, one lane per term: term 1 train it on purpose, term 2 memory then attention, term 3 how it is made and how it is asked, term 4 agents, evidence and the system card. Weeks 1 to 17 are solid and done. Week 18, a assess week in term 2, is tinted pink with a thick border and a pointer above it. Weeks 19 to 36 are still dashed.
